actions.description: The Benefits Management Plan defines credible, verifiable target benefits tied to hypotheses and sparks, named owners, realistic milestone timeframes, falsifiable metrics, and concrete disbenefit mitigations -- approve it to authorize benefits realization planning
The Benefits Management Plan fails to establish credible benefits, lacks verifiable metrics, or ignores significant disbenefits -- reject it outright
The Benefits Management Plan requires further metric definition, timeframe alignment, or risk mitigation before it can be judged

metadata.decision_context: Governance review for Stage 4 Benefits Management Plan

complexity_profile.rationale: Reused directly from sidpa-template's own shared-complexity-profile.json, which itself was corrected from a real ADPA mistake (approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
